accepted_boundaries: Only the owned block render event or explicit SDCW_enqueue_scripts integration queues frontend assets
Arbitrary raw HTML/cached fragments need explicit enqueue; no global discovery
A later parent/filter can remove a rendered clock while leaving queued assets
Normal WordPress footer lifecycle is required; block editor previews are an explicit exception to unused-frontend rules
Original public 1.1.2 saves on Core 6.3 can damage previously malformed metadata; erased data cannot be reconstructed
separate_nonblocking_gates: Hosted required PR checks: cannot run without the explicitly forbidden push; local CI is recorded separately
WordPress/CDN publication, merge and owner-site installation: not authorized
New comparative TTFB/PHP-memory benchmark: not part of current render-event contract; no prior timings transfer
Native LocalWP/Safari/VoiceOver, multisite, arbitrary external optimizer and public font availability certification: not included in the established local contract

reviewers.native_lead: Independent fresh native execution plus review of supplemental and CI raw receipts
reviewers.gatekeeper: Independent full raw readback and all 13 gate decisions
reviewers.root_supplemental: Supplemental native lifecycle execution; independently read by native lead and gatekeeper
